Google releases Gemini 3.7 Flash.

The model is designed to plan more carefully, handle tool calls more reliably and require fewer retries. It will also power Gemini Spark, Google’s 24/7 personal agent.

The benchmarks are Google’s own launch claims, but the combination is aggressive: a stronger model, shipped after just three weeks, at $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens through year-end.
